name: ABcreate Warranty Desk for WooCommerce
author: ABCreate

sections.description:
From 22 October 2026 the Italian Consumer Code, as amended by Legislative Decree 176/2026, changes how shops handle the legal guarantee of conformity for contracts concluded from 31 July 2026:

  • before repairing or replacing a product, the seller must inform the consumer of the choice between repair and replacement, and of the extension that a repair brings (art. 135-bis, paragraph 2-bis);
  • when the remedy is a repair, the seller’s liability is extended once by 12 months (art. 133, paragraph 1-bis);
  • a refurbished replacement is allowed only on the consumer’s explicit request (art. 135-ter).

Warranty Desk helps an Italian WooCommerce shop keep track of all this. It records, computes and reminds; it never decides whether a defect is covered.

What it does

  • Dates for every unit sold: end of the presumption (12 months), end of the guarantee (24 months, or what was agreed for used goods, at least 12, stored on the order line at the sale), prescription (26 months), all from the delivery date. Months are counted as the Civil Code says: 29 February 2028 plus 12 months is 28 February 2029.
  • Claims: one claim per reported defect, on one or more units of an order line, with the steps of the law in order: informativa, consumer’s choice, goods received, optional replacement good on loan, remedy.
  • Informativa by email: a ready text based on art. 135-bis, paragraph 2-bis, that you can replace with your own. A copy goes into the order notes. If WordPress does not confirm the email, the claim goes to review and nothing is sent again automatically.
  • Extension after a repair: applied once per unit, only when the contract dates from 31 July 2026, the buyer is a consumer and the defect appeared within the guarantee (the day it appeared is recorded apart from the day it was reported). A second repair adds nothing. Whether the guarantee starts again after a replacement is not settled by the law: the plugin keeps the original end and lets you record a new end you decide.
  • Price reduction and termination: linked to a native WooCommerce refund. Termination is refused for a minor defect.
  • Business buyers: an order with a company name or a VAT number hides the dates until you confirm whether the buyer is a consumer.
  • Checks when something changes: a refund of the units, a cancelled order or an edited order line sends the claim to review instead of guessing, and WooCommerce is read again before a repair or a replacement is recorded.
  • Proof of the informativa: the full text, recipient and language are kept in the claim’s history, for emails and for informativa given by phone or in person.
  • EU harmonised notice: upload the official notice (Regulation (EU) 2025/1960, mandatory from 27 September 2026) and the plugin shows it in the footer and at checkout, and warns you while it is missing.
  • Complete history and export: every change is recorded with who, when and why. Mistakes are fixed with new entries, never by deleting history. Export claims and history as CSV.

What it does not do

Warranty Desk never changes your stock, totals, order status or refunds: WooCommerce stays in charge of them. It does not decide whether a defect is covered, and it does not give legal advice. It helps you manage the legal guarantee; it does not make your shop compliant by itself.

Out of scope in this version: shops that repair for a fee as their business, imports from outside the EU, digital content and digital services, and sales through marketplaces (the seller in the contract may be the marketplace, and the order imported into WooCommerce does not prove the dates). The 14-day right of withdrawal is a different thing from the legal guarantee: handle those returns in WooCommerce.

Compatibility

  • Works with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and with the classic order storage.
  • Ready for translation through translate.wordpress.org.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or search for “Warranty Desk”, and activate it.
  3. Open WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Warranty Desk: set the transit days used to estimate deliveries, check the informativa text and upload the EU harmonised notice.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Warranty Desk, or the box on any order, to open a claim.

Administrators and shop managers get access automatically.
sections.faq:
Which orders does it apply to?

Every paid order. The new rules (informativa and extension) apply to contracts concluded from 31 July 2026; the plugin uses the order date as the contract date and shows it. Older orders keep the previous rules: 24 months, no extension, informativa not required.

Where does the delivery date come from?

Until you confirm it by hand, it is estimated: the day the order was completed plus the transit days you set. A courier or tracking plugin can give the real date through the abcreate_wd_delivery filter. “Out of warranty” can be chosen only with a confirmed delivery.

What about the 26-month prescription?

It is shown next to the guarantee. After the extension it can fall before the end of the guarantee; the plugin flags this and never closes a claim because of it.

Can units of the same line have different outcomes?

Yes: open one claim per unit (or per group of units with the same outcome). A claim records one outcome for all its units.

Does it send emails?

Only the informativa, and only when you press the button. It uses the WooCommerce email template.

Is my data deleted when I remove the plugin?

Only if you ask for it: enable the option in WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Warranty Desk before deleting the plugin. Export the CSV first. By default the data is kept, so a reinstall finds the history.

Does it contact external services?

No. All data stays in your WordPress database.
sections.changelog:
0.1.0

  • First release: guarantee dates per unit, claims with informativa, choice, loan and remedies, 12-month extension after a repair, price reduction and termination through WooCommerce refunds, review of changed orders, EU harmonised notice, CSV export, ready for translation.

short_description: Italian legal guarantee claims for WooCommerce: guarantee dates per unit, the consumer informativa, the 12-month extension after a repair.

screenshots.caption: The claims to handle, those in review first, with the days since the report.
A claim: the units with their dates and the next steps in order.
A repaired unit: the guarantee extended by 12 months, the prescription flagged, the complete history.
A claim in review: the order has a VAT number and the buyer must be confirmed.
Opening a claim from an order: the dates of every unit before anything is saved.
